fidelity_limits: No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal-attribution tool exists (capability_unavailable); a single execution and one paired comparison cannot establish a dominant settling cause, so any coordinate improvement is a measured association, not an attributed mechanism.

search.family_coordinate@1.0.0 supplies candidate ask/tell only; each coordinate still requires validated candidate preparation plus fresh simulation.run, evaluation.run, control.profile_report and a frozen bound comparison, and this stage executes no batch and promotes no candidate.

Raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked (F141, F286); local or raw weighted cost values cannot serve as the final physical ranking, which is joint acceptance first and otherwise componentwise physical comparison of terminal_error_m, holding_max_error_m and holding_max_speed_m_s (F363).
Sampled holding evidence covers only the final 0.05 s (6 samples, F101, F71) with no continuous-time guarantee (F185, F331); the holding metrics are sampled maxima, not continuous-time certification.

effective_horizon, optimization_raw_status and optimization_selected_iteration (F640, F681, F662, F690, F635) are controller-side plan records, not backend motion, and are not causal evidence; the performed check read only 8 of 35 update records, so the other 27 remain not_read.

Frames are kept distinct: world for tip vectors, projected GVS coordinates for state, serial backend joint coordinates for q/qdot; applied updates (35) are distinct from optimized noninitialization selections (6).

Full historical warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained (control_snapshots.json absent); provider transport failures may be retried a bounded number of times (stated in planned_budget.model_calls) and are not scientific evidence.
arguments.hypothesis: On the frozen baseline, joint_reach_holding_acceptance fails (F402) only in the holding window while terminal reach passes (F47, F62 inside the 0.01 m tolerance F456); raising the two granted tip-speed weight coordinates — holding_tip_speed_weight upward from its saved 0.05 and terminal_tip_speed_weight upward from its saved 0.0 — can reduce the sampled final-window holding max tip speed (F160 = 1.1750052670100422 m/s vs limit F440 = 0.02 m/s) and holding max position error (F32 = 0.05650455971948983 m vs limit F456 = 0.01 m) toward the settling limits without losing the terminal-reach margin, if the effect of the already-applied 0.0->0.05 holding change (delta speed F301 = -0.4060100069642385 m/s against baseline F58) continues monotonically and is not dominated by the persistent compute-budget/horizon truncation observed in the plan records (F90/F29 deadline_misses 35 of 35 at F274/F76 = 0.01 s control period; F640 = 7, F691 = 5, F711 = 3, F681 = 1 effective_horizon over the final window).
arguments.rationale: Authored from the accepted revision artifact f4499792c577e668e648ed0bba2435d312f5a83dc774dbd4e329d2f3482fcc4d and the performed check result artifact 0013c7bdcac007c4071228871541b353a1fbf05cb766cacb4be709b6061e9056 (aliases F628-F723), which together record the only executed change as control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.05 with terminal_tip_speed_weight left at 0.0 (F462, F538, F454). That change is a sealed physical_tradeoff (F199): sampled holding improved but still fails (holding_max_speed_m_s 1.1750052670100422 against 0.02 m/s, F160/F440; holding_max_error_m 0.05650455971948983 against 0.01 m, F32/F456; holding_position_passed false F12, holding_speed_passed false F25), while terminal reach worsened but still passes (candidate 0.00869890424761182 m F62, delta +0.001056295661744434 m F97, terminal_reach_passed true F47) and computation worsened (delta mean_complete_update_s +0.5154540428891785 s, F235, with deadline_misses unchanged at 35, F153/F90/F29). Joint acceptance is unchanged at false (F402), so no candidate is selected here and this plan selects nothing; the diagnostic deferral of causal attribution (rec-defer-causal-replay) is kept separate from this search plan and is not converted into a value. Because the only two parameters under a standing grant are the tip-speed weights, the plan probes exactly those two coordinates at the fixed controller controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 with the robot, task, acceptance, controller implementation and other numerical settings held fixed. Domains respect the legal rule (zero or >= 0.0001) and contain the saved starting values 0.0 and 0.05; step 0.05 moves 0.05 to 0.10/0.00 and 0.0 to 0.05, never entering the forbidden tiny-positive interval (0, 0.0001). Six candidates at 4 tool calls, 1 backend solve and 990 s each keep the planned budget within the phase's non-executing scope (backend_solves = max_candidates = 6; tool_calls 24 >= 4x6; wall_s 5940 >= 990x6; workers 0); model_calls 8 only covers bounded provider attempts and is not evidence. Objectives are joint acceptance first, then the three recorded physical metrics plus complete-update cost, because the paired comparison shows holding gains accompanied by reach and computation losses: any improvement with a worsening elsewhere is a trade-off, not overall improvement (F286), and raw weighted cost under different weights is never the final ranking (F141). Fidelity is limited by the absence of closed-loop counterfactual replay, by the 8-of-35 sampled plan view, by the final-window-only holding sampling (F101/F71, no continuous-time guarantee F185/F331), and by the fact that the late effective_horizon truncation (F640, F691, F711, F681) and budget-driven stopping (F662, F690 with User_Requested_Stop, F635 selected iteration 68 under max_iterations 120 F525) remain controller-side plan records rather than backend motion, which is exactly why the promise is only uncertain.
stopping_conditions: Stop the batch after max_candidates = 6 coordinate candidates or when the planned_budget (24 tool calls, 6 backend solves, 5940 s wall, 0 workers) is exhausted, whichever comes first.

Stop early and report success only if a candidate yields joint_reach_holding_acceptance true (holding position and speed inside the recorded limits and terminal reach retained), verified by the frozen acceptance comparison rather than by raw weighted cost.
Stop a candidate immediately on any force-bound violation, solver error, non-finite state, or invalid/incomplete execution; record it as a constraint failure rather than a physical result.

Stop and report separability as unresolved if deadline_misses remains 35 of 35 and effective_horizon stays truncated below the configured horizon 10, since weight-only coordinates then cannot be separated from compute-budget/horizon truncation.
Halt a candidate after at most two bounded provider attempts on transport failure; a transport failure is not evidence about the hypothesis.
Terminate this stage without executing any batch or promoting any candidate: a validated plan requires a future grant.
weakening_observations: The single executed weight change (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0->0.05, F462 -> F538) moved the sampled holding max speed by only -0.4060100069642385 m/s (F301) from 1.5810152739742807 (F58) to 1.1750052670100422 (F160), still about 59x the 0.02 m/s limit (F440); a coordinate increase in the same weight may therefore be low-yield rather than settling the failure.

The same change worsened terminal reach (candidate-minus-baseline terminal_error_m +0.001056295661744434, F97; candidate 0.00869890424761182, F62) while terminal_tip_speed_weight stayed 0.0 (F454), so raising the terminal tip-speed coordinate may erode a reach margin that is already only 0.0013 m inside the 0.01 m tolerance (F456).

Computation stayed saturated and unsolved: deadline_misses is 35 of 35 updates in both runs (F90, F29; delta F153 = 0) at 0.01 s control period (F274, F76) with mean complete-update 17.77877309145406 s (F114), and the performed plans check records effective_horizon truncating to 7, 5, 3 and 1 (F640, F691, F711, F681) below the configured horizon 10 (F537), with User_Requested_Stop at updates 8 and 28 (F662, F690) under max_iterations 120 (F525); holding-cost nodes may be evaluated over a shortened horizon, so a weight coordinate may not act as the objective scaling intends.

Sampled per-channel applied tension reaches 7.999998299677138 N at update 30 (F699) against the 8.0 N per-tendon limit, so pushing tip-speed penalties harder may be limited by the force bound even though force_bound_violation_n is 0.0 in both runs (F343).
